holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.37% fund weight, its -20.79% return over 3 months made it the largest detractor in the fund, reducing returns by an estimated 0.701%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.94% position, its 62.6% return generated an estimated 1.84% gain, serving as the fund's second largest positive contributor.

holdings.why_it_matters: The 2.85% allocation gained 28.02% over 3 months, adding an estimated 0.799% to portfolio returns within the fund's largest sector, Consumer Discretionary.

June 2026 sales reached Rs 1,300 crore with net profit of Rs 106 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 1.83% fund weight, its -14.63% quarterly return reduced total fund gains by an estimated 0.268% in the Materials pocket.

portfolio.statement: DSP Small Cap Fund gained 1.64% over the last 3 months, as sharp outperformance in auto ancillaries and pipe manufacturing outweighed drops in retail jewellery and industrial machinery.
interp: Top contributors Lumax Auto Technologies and Welspun Corp added a combined 3.83% estimated contribution, preserving positive portfolio returns.
Retractions in Thangamayil Jewellery and Kirloskar Oil Engines shaved off over 1.08% combined from quarterly gains.
portfolio.line: Auto component and pipe manufacturers drove quarterly gains while retail jewellery and regulatory scrutiny in dairy created headwinds.

drivers.text: Lumax Auto Technologies rose 38.67% over 3 months, contributing an estimated 1.995% following steady operating profits of Rs 190 crore in June 2026.
Welspun Corp generated an estimated 1.84% contribution as its share price rose 62.6% alongside rating reaffirmations and cross-border expansion.
Thangamayil Jewellery dropped 20.79% over 3 months, deducting an estimated 0.701% despite continuing store additions in Tamil Nadu.

themes.title: Automotive Supply Chain Integration
themes.text: Substantial portfolio exposure to automotive equipment providers delivering expanding sales volumes.

themes.title: Industrial Materials & Pipe Infrastructure
themes.text: Capitalization on large-scale infrastructure orders and chemical capacity.

macro.why: Order intake and OEM production levels govern quarterly volume growth and plant utilization.

macro.factor: Food Safety and Domestic Regulatory Compliance
macro.why: Enforcement actions by safety regulators can impact commercial operations and sentiment.

priced_in.text: Welspun Corp's multi-quarter profit expansion and credit profile stability are factored in after a 62.6% 3-month rally.
Sansera Engineering's valuation of 72.06 times earnings reflects consistent quarterly revenue expansion up to Rs 1,021 crore.

could_change.title: Food Safety Regulatory Outcomes
could_change.text: The severity and findings of FSSAI prosecution against Dodla Dairy could alter consumer trust and operational run-rates.

could_change.title: Automotive OEM Volume Swings
could_change.text: Any cyclical shift in vehicle production would directly hit the fund's heavy 24.3% allocation to Consumer Discretionary component suppliers.

portfolio.risk_note: The portfolio has 43.4% of assets concentrated across Consumer Discretionary (24.3%) and Materials (19.1%), exposing returns to vehicle manufacturing cycles and commodity fluctuations.
